mapper.select: SELECT pa.id, pa.project_id, pa.user_id, pa.agent_id, pa.status, pa.create_time, pa.update_time, sa.name, sa.role FROM sys_project_agent pa LEFT JOIN sys_agent sa ON sa.id = pa.agent_id WHERE pa.project_id = #{projectId} AND pa.user_id = #{userId} AND pa.deleted = 0 ORDER BY pa.id ASC
